content.title: 3 Value Stocks We Find Risky
content.summary: Value investing has created more billionaires than any other strategy, like Warren Buffett, who built his fortune by purchasing wonderful businesses at reasonable prices. But these hidden gems are few and far between - many stocks that appear cheap often stay that way because they face structural issues.

content.title: Bloomingdale's Momentum Strengthens Macy's Luxury-Led Growth Profile

content.title: Is Dillard's Digital Growth Enough to Offset Store Traffic Slump?

content.title: The biggest retail challenges anticipated in 2026
content.description:
Forrester Research Retail Analyst Sucharita Kodali sits down with Yahoo Finance markets and data editor Jared Blikre on Market Catalysts to discuss the headwinds that major retailers are expecting for 2026, including weather patterns and the interest rate environment.

Also catch Sucharita Kodali look back on 2025's consumer spending trends.
